# Genetic Counselor Leaders

## How can GARDE help the genetic counseling team? {-}

<hr style="border:0; border-top:1px solid #d9d9d9; margin:0 0 22px 0;"> <div style="float:left; width:47%; margin:0 30px 0 0;"> <img src="resources/images/GARDE-process.png" alt="GARDE workflow" style="width:100%; display:block;"> <p style="margin:10px 0 18px 0;"> <em>Figure 1. GARDE process</em> </p> <p style="margin:0;"> Under a genetic counselor’s supervision, a genetic counseling assistant enters genetic test orders for patients who choose to pursue genetic testing. GARDE allows genetic counselors to focus on patients with more complex needs. </p> </div> <div style="float:right; width:50%;"> <p style="margin:0 0 18px 0; color:#4a76c0; font-style:italic; font-size:1.15rem; line-height:1.2;"> How can GARDE help the genetic counseling team? </p> <p style="margin:0 0 18px 0;"> The demand for clinicians with genetics expertise is increasing and the supply of genetic counselors isn’t keeping pace with the growing demand. </p> <p style="margin:0;"> GARDE facilitates the population-based identification of high-risk patients based on data already available in the EHR. Patient outreach and education occur through a <a href="https://garde.utah.edu/garde-chat.html">customizable chatbot</a>. </p> <div style="margin-top:24px; border-top:4px solid #000; border-bottom:4px solid #000; padding:12px 0;"> <p style="margin:0 0 10px 0;"> “With GARDE and the chatbot, we were able to customize patient interactions so that our patients still knew a human was involved in their care.” </p> <p style="margin:0;"> — Genetic Counselor leader from an implementation site </p> </div> </div> <div style="clear:both;"></div>  
## How can GARDE help my patients?{-}
<p> We anticipate that GARDE with a chatbot will allow genetic counselors to prioritize patient psychosocial needs over education and information-gathering tasks while maintaining patient satisfaction with the care they receive. </p>
